title: The open gaps of the mecm, intune, autopilot, entra, graph, defender and auth articles are researched from official sources or noted with what was tried
goal: every _gaps.md entry open on 2026-10-20 whose first topic is under the mecm, intune, autopilot, entra, graph, defender and auth articles carries a closing note (Resolved, Partly resolved, Narrowed or Closed) citing the official sources researched into its article, or a Tried note dated 2026-10-21 or later saying what was searched and what source, lab or login would answer it; the fact count under those topics does not fall, since no fact is deleted

run:
import re, sys
sys.path.insert(0, '_tools')
import kbfacts
L, P, F = 'public/_gaps.md', ('mecm/', 'intune/', 'autopilot/', 'entra/', 'graph/', 'defender/', 'auth/'), '2026-10-21'
N = re.compile(r'\b(?:Looked|Tried|Still open|Resolved|Reviewed|Closed|Narrowed|Partly resolved|Mostly resolved|Superseded):? (20\d\d-\d\d-\d\d)')
C = re.compile(r'(?:^|\s)- (?:Resolved|Superseded|Closed|Reviewed|Partly resolved|Mostly resolved|Narrowed)\b')
es = kbfacts.ledger_entries(L)
kbfacts.link_entries(es)
top = lambda e: (e['explicit'] or e['via_sources'] or ['public/?'])[0].split('/', 1)[1]
left = [e['line'] for e in es if not C.search(e['text']) and top(e).startswith(P) and max(N.findall(e['text']) or ['0']) < F]
print(len(left), 'open', L, 'entries under', P, 'with no note dated', F, 'or later, lines:', left[:25])
sys.exit(1 if left else 0)

import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '_tools')
import kbfacts
P, B = ('mecm/', 'intune/', 'autopilot/', 'entra/', 'graph/', 'defender/', 'auth/'), 4466
n = sum(len(kbfacts.units('public/' + p)) for p in P)
print(n, 'fact units under', P, '- at least', B, 'on 2026-10-20')
sys.exit(0 if n >= B else 1)
